title: Quarterly orchestration plan for Hosted API + Model Catalog lineup (Tranche-based rollouts and OKR alignment)
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Objective: Produce a pragmatic, tranche-based quarterly roadmap that sequences Hosted API feature launches and model-catalog rotations to meet Q2 OKRs (latency improvement, cost-per-token reduction, and model health SLA). This ticket captures the orchestration plan, acceptance criteria, rollout schedule, dependencies across Eng/Design/SRE, and the gating criteria for canary and full rollouts. It is intended to be the single source of truth for the PM/Eng/Design sync for this initiative.
acceptance_criteria: 1) Deliver a tranche schedule with exact dates and owners for canary and global rollout; 2) Document gating criteria (telemetry thresholds, eval pass rate, cost delta limits); 3) Cross-team playbook for rollback and fallbacks; 4) Coordinate Canaries with Dedicated capacity reservations and routing policies; 5) Communicate roadmap and guardrails to sales and account teams before tranche 1 launch.
notes: Key constraints: model catalog rotation windows must avoid accounting month cutovers; Dedicated capacity procurement lead time is 3 weeks; evaluation harness requires a stable prompt bank maintained by Research. We will favor gradual model variant swaps with automatic fallback to previous variant if error rate > 1.2% over 15m.
discussion: 2026-01-07 - Marcus Lee: Initial scoping complete. Need Eng commitment on kernel rollout timeline and whether quantized variants are production-ready for tranche 2.
2026-01-12 - Priya Nair (Eng): Kernel changes scoped; ETA for infra rollouts is 2026-02-16. Requesting additional estimate buffer for KV cache migration.
2026-01-20 - Elena Gomez (Design): UX for model-selection in Console needs a compact variant selector for canary groups. Assigning DES-1189 for mockups.

2026-01-26 - Security (Lena Wu): Confirmed no extra encryption work required for hosted-facing metadata, but audit logging for private deployments is outstanding (blocker for some enterprise accounts).
2026-02-02 - Aisha Patel (PM): Added dependencies to ENG-40212 for batching flags and to DES-1103 for rollout banner components. Scheduling cross-functional review 2026-02-10.

2026-02-10 - Review notes: Agreed gating thresholds: P50 latency must not regress by >10%; cost-per-token delta must be <= -5% (improvement) or neutral; model quality (eval set) must maintain >95% baseline accuracy for key intents.
decision_log: 2026-01-14: Decide to split rollout into three tranches to reduce blast radius and allow telemetry-driven adjustments.
2026-01-30: Chosen default fallback policy: route to previous stable model variant + throttle new variant to 10% traffic for 60 minutes during canary unless SLOs stable.
2026-02-10: Agreed to reserve Dedicated burst pool for tranche 2 to simulate high-throughput scenarios for quantized models.
risk_register: Risk: Model quality regression detected post-rollout. Mitigation: require full eval harness run and human spot-checking for three critical intents before escalation.
Risk: Dedicated capacity shortfall due to procurement windows. Mitigation: pre-commit pool and fallback to hosted burst with cost guardrails.
Risk: Observability gaps for new kernel metrics. Mitigation: ENG to add metric emitters and dashboard tiles before tranche 1 canary.
Risk: Enterprise customers dependent on audit logging for private deployments. Mitigation: flag customers and schedule targeted communication and migration path.
rollout_schedule: Tranche 1 (Canary): 2026-03-01 -> 2026-03-08; target 5-10% traffic; owners: Eng (Marcus), PM (Aisha), Design (Elena); gating: telemetry steady for 48h.
Tranche 2 (Scale test): 2026-03-15 -> 2026-03-22; target 30-40% traffic + Dedicated burst validation; owners: Eng infra (Priya), SRE; gating: sustained throughput test and KV cache hit-rate >= 70%.
Tranche 3 (Full rollout): 2026-03-28; full traffic shift with phasing per-region; owner: PM release lead; gating: all previous gates green and exec sign-off.
